description: PAID, per call: look up a federally incorporated corporation by name or by corporation number, in Corporations Canada's published Federal Corporations data. Returns up to 10 matches (exact name first, then names that start with it, then names that contain it; active first), each with corporation number, business number, name, governing Act, status, the anniversary and last filing dates, the registered office address and the minimum and maximum number of directors, plus the total matched and the attribution. The address is shortened to city, province and the first three characters of the postal code for every corporation. Director names are not included. This is not the official record. You are not charged when nothing matches.

corporation_number.description: The federal corporation number, digits only or with a hyphen before the check digit.

name.description: A corporate name, or part of one. Give this or corporation_number, not both.

name: search_federal_corporations
